summary: Master integrated data collection, visualization, and mapping using ODK, Tableau, Power BI, and OpenStreetMap with our comprehensive training course.
lede: Integrated data collection, visualization and mapping training connects ODK, XLSForm, Tableau, Power BI, OpenStreetMap and QGIS across the data lifecycle. You will practise building digital field forms, applying validation and data-governance checks, preparing analysis-ready datasets, and turning results into dashboards and map-based reports. The course uses structured modules, practice datasets and realistic fieldwork scenarios to develop practical deliverables, including a collection form, quality-control checklist, dashboard prototype, map package and implementation roadmap. It also introduces API concepts, automated refresh, AI-assisted data-quality review and operational spatial analysis while addressing challenges such as intermittent connectivity, limited device capacity, inconsistent coding and incomplete metadata.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, manage, analyse or communicate location-aware field data. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a connected workflow across ODK, Tableau, Power BI and OpenStreetMap, including professionals responsible for field operations, monitoring, research, GIS and reporting.
prerequisites: You need basic spreadsheet skills and a practical reason to collect, analyse or map field data. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with survey questions, operational indicators or geographic coordinates will help, but the course introduces the foundations of ODK, Tableau, Power BI, OpenStreetMap and QGIS progressively. Advanced concepts such as API integration, automated refresh and AI-assisted anomaly review are taught at operational application level. Hands-on exercises use practice datasets and templates, while software installation depends on your organization's device and licensing policies.
